description: This is a Java source file implementing an Android IntentService called UtilityService. It provides background operations such as geofence management, location updates, notifications, and communication with a wearable device. The class includes methods for handling geofence triggers, requesting location updates, showing notifications about nearby attractions, and transferring data to a wearable device. It integrates with Google Play Services APIs, Glide for image loading, and Android support libraries.

classes.name: UtilityService
classes.description: An Android IntentService providing background functions such as geofence management, location updates, notification handling, and communication with a wearable device in the XYZTouristAttractions app.
